abstract: We prove the existence of a competitive equilibrium in an exchange economy with incomplete markets, where preferences may be discontinuous, non-ordered, price-dependent, and interdependent (externalities allowed), and no survival or interiority of the initial endowments assumption is imposed. Thus, we bring the existence of an equilibrium with incomplete asset markets to the “state of the art” level.

title: Matching to Suppliers in the Production Network: a Quantitative Framework
title_zh: 生产网络中的供应商匹配：一个定量分析框架
title_primary: 生产网络中的供应商匹配：一个定量分析框架
title_secondary: Matching to Suppliers in the Production Network: a Quantitative Framework
authors: Alfaro-Ureña, Alonso, Zacchia, Paolo
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Microeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We build a model of production network formation that enables econometric estimation of the determinants of supplier choice, like trade costs or matching frictions. The model informs an estimator obtained from a transformation of the multinomial logit likelihood function that conditions on two network statistics: the out-degree of sellers (a sufficient statistic for the seller marginal costs) and the in-degree of buyers (which is determined by decisions of buyers, like “make-or-buy”). In an empirical application, this estimator shows that a prominent Costa Rican highway fostered firm-to-firm connections between core and peripheral regions, and within the core regions themselves.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个生产网络形成模型，该模型能够对供应商选择的决定因素（如贸易成本或匹配摩擦）进行计量经济学估计。该模型指导了一种估计方法，该方法通过对多项逻辑似然函数进行变换获得，并基于两个网络统计量进行条件设定：卖方的出度（作为卖方边际成本的充分统计量）和买方的入度（由买方决策决定，如“制造或购买”）。在一项实证应用中，该估计方法表明，哥斯达黎加一条著名的高速公路促进了核心区域与边缘区域之间，以及核心区域内部的企业间联系。

title: The effects of education on corruption: Evidence from Vietnam’s university expansion
title_zh: 教育对腐败的影响：来自越南大学扩招的证据
title_primary: 教育对腐败的影响：来自越南大学扩招的证据
title_secondary: The effects of education on corruption: Evidence from Vietnam’s university expansion
authors: Edmund J. Malesky, Martin Mattsson, Khoa Vu, Liaoliang Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Education and corruption are negatively correlated at the cross-national level, but little is known about the causal relationship between the two. We combine newly-collected data on timing and locations of Vietnam’s national expansion of universities with detailed survey data on experiences of corruption from over 170,000 respondents in 320 districts across 12 years. Using staggered difference-in-differences, we show that cohorts exposed to the university expansion are 87% more likely to have a university education. However, this increase neither translates into fewer individuals being affected by corruption nor increases the propensity to denounce corrupt officials. Instead, we find that education increases the incidence of bribe requests and perceptions of corruption. The mechanism most consistent with our data is that higher education raises household income, and that the associated rise in the opportunity cost of time and in exposure to bribe-prone situations increases exposure to corruption.
abstract_zh: 教育与腐败在国家层面呈负相关，但关于二者之间的因果关系知之甚少。我们将新收集的越南全国大学扩张时间与地点数据，与涵盖12年间320个地区超过17万名受访者的详细腐败经历调查数据相结合。采用交错双重差分法，我们发现暴露于大学扩张的队列获得大学教育的可能性高出87%。然而，这一增长既未转化为受腐败影响的个体减少，也未提高举报腐败官员的倾向。相反，我们发现教育增加了贿赂索求的发生率和腐败感知。与我们的数据最一致的机制是，高等教育提高了家庭收入，而随之而来的时间机会成本上升及暴露于易受贿赂情境的增加，加剧了腐败暴露风险。

title: There is no Forward Guidance Puzzle
title_zh: 不存在前瞻指引之谜
title_primary: 不存在前瞻指引之谜
title_secondary: There is no Forward Guidance Puzzle
authors: Martin Blomhoff Holm, SeHyoun Ahn
official: 官方在线 2026-08-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: According to the forward guidance puzzle, the economy responds more strongly to future than current interest rate cuts in many policy models used by central banks. We show that the puzzle arises only if three conditions are met: (1) a future interest rate cut is announced, (2) an interest rate peg precedes it, and (3) agents are assumed to attribute the peg exclusively to a sequence of monetary policy shocks. Absent any of these conditions, the response to a promised future interest rate cut weakens with the anticipation horizon, and forward guidance is no longer a forceful policy.
abstract_zh: 根据前瞻指引之谜，在许多央行使用的政策模型中，经济对未来利率下调的反应强于对当前利率下调的反应。我们表明，这一谜题仅在满足三个条件时才会出现：（1）宣布未来利率下调，（2）在此之前存在利率钉住，（3）假设代理人将钉住完全归因于一系列货币政策冲击。若缺少任一条件，对承诺的未来利率下调的反应会随预期期限延长而减弱，前瞻指引不再是一项强有力的政策。

title: DP21615 Who Wins and Who Loses in Prediction Markets? Evidence from Polymarket
title_zh: 预测市场中的赢家与输家：来自Polymarket的证据
title_primary: 预测市场中的赢家与输家：来自Polymarket的证据
title_secondary: DP21615 Who Wins and Who Loses in Prediction Markets? Evidence from Polymarket
authors: Pat Akey, Vincent Grégoire, Nicolas Harvie, Charles Martineau
official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study trading gains and losses on Polymarket, the largest prediction market by trading volume. Using 588 million trades ($67 billion in volume), we show that the gains are highly concentrated: the top 1% of users with positive PnL capture 76.5% of profits. Successful traders provide liquidity using limit orders that resolve favorably relative to realized outcomes while unsuccessful traders take liquidity using market orders. Monthly performance is modestly persistent, however this may represent sample selection rather than skill. A detailed analysis of the trading behavior of the most successful accounts suggests that “insider” trading is unlikely to explain the performance of the largest winners.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了Polymarket——按交易量计最大的预测市场——上的交易盈亏情况。基于5.88亿笔交易（交易额达670亿美元），我们发现收益高度集中：盈利用户中前1%的账户占据了76.5%的利润。成功的交易者通过限价单提供流动性，这些订单相对于已实现结果有利地结算，而不成功的交易者则通过市价单消耗流动性。月度表现具有适度持续性，然而这可能反映的是样本选择而非技能。对最成功账户交易行为的详细分析表明，“内幕”交易不太可能解释最大赢家的表现。

title: Household Responses to Drinking Water Contamination: Evidence from Public Notification, Bottled Water Consumption, and Infant Health
title_zh: 家庭对饮用水污染的反应：来自公共通知、瓶装水消费与婴儿健康的证据
title_primary: 家庭对饮用水污染的反应：来自公共通知、瓶装水消费与婴儿健康的证据
title_secondary: Household Responses to Drinking Water Contamination: Evidence from Public Notification, Bottled Water Consumption, and Infant Health
authors: Guo, Jiahui, Ren, Yongwang, Wang, Xibo, Zhang, Ruohao, Zhang, Wendong 等
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines household avoidance behavior in response to drinking water contamination under the Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA). A major challenge in studying behavioral responses to public notifications is that the timing recorded in the Safe Drinking Water Information System (SDWIS) often does not accurately reflect when contamination information becomes publicly available. To address this issue, this study combines SDWIS violation records with detailed water testing data from the EPA’s Six-Year Review (SYR) to infer more accurate notification timing for Tier 1 drinking water violations. The analysis links public water system service areas to weekly store-level bottled-water sales data and estimates dynamic responses using a staggered event-study design. Preliminary results show a sharp increase in bottled-water sales immediately following contamination notifications. When notification timing is measured using the SYR generation date, bottled-water sales increase by approximately 40 percent in the week after notification, substantially larger than estimates based on EPA enforcement dates. The findings suggest that inaccurate administrative timing may substantially attenuate estimated behavioral responses in prior studies and highlight the importance of precise notification timing when evaluating environmental information disclosure policies.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了《安全饮用水法》（SDWA）下家庭对饮用水污染信息的规避行为。研究公众通知行为反应的一大挑战在于，《安全饮用水信息系统》（SDWIS）中记录的时间往往不能准确反映污染信息向公众公开的实际时点。为解决这一问题，本研究将SDWIS违规记录与美国环保署（EPA）六年审查（SYR）中的详细水质检测数据相结合，以推断一级饮用水违规通知的更准确时间。分析将公共供水系统服务区域与周度商店层面的瓶装水销售数据相链接，并采用交错事件研究设计估计动态反应。初步结果显示，污染通知发布后瓶装水销售立即出现显著增长。当使用SYR生成日期衡量通知时间时，通知后一周内瓶装水销售增长约40%，显著大于基于EPA执法日期估计的结果。研究结果表明，行政记录时间的不准确可能大幅低估以往研究中估计的行为反应，并凸显了在评估环境信息披露政策时精确通知时间的重要性。

title: Household consumption and savings over the life cycle: The roles of demographics and durables
title_zh: 生命周期中的家庭消费与储蓄：人口结构与耐用消费品的作用
title_primary: 生命周期中的家庭消费与储蓄：人口结构与耐用消费品的作用
title_secondary: Household consumption and savings over the life cycle: The roles of demographics and durables
authors: Neha Bairoliya, Areendam Chanda, Jingyi Fang, Fang Yang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The canonical prediction of life-cycle models, that individuals smooth consumption over their lifetime, has mostly been tested in developed countries and found little empirical support. We provide a novel developing-country perspective by analyzing patterns of life-cycle consumption, income, and savings rates in India. In contrast to the U.S., Indian households exhibit little growth in nondurable consumption expenditures after adjusting for family size. Surprisingly, this flat adjusted profile coexists with substantial income growth and a sharp rise in the savings/surplus rate over the life cycle. We show that lumpy non-housing durable accumulation is an important use of this life-cycle surplus, helping reconcile high savings rates with flat measured adult-equivalent nondurable consumption. Quantitatively, non-housing durable stock growth accounts for about one-third of accumulated life-cycle surplus by age 45, and an augmented expenditure profile that adds imputed non-housing durable investment flows to nondurables raises adult-equivalent life-cycle growth from 8.4% to 27.9%.
abstract_zh: 生命周期模型的经典预测——个体在一生中平滑消费——主要在发达国家得到检验，但实证支持甚少。我们通过分析印度的生命周期消费、收入及储蓄率模式，提供了一个新颖的发展中国家视角。与美国的状况相反，印度家庭在调整家庭规模后，非耐用品消费支出几乎没有增长。令人惊讶的是，这种平稳的调整后消费曲线与显著的收入增长及生命周期中储蓄/盈余率的急剧上升并存。我们表明，非住房耐用品的大额积累是这一生命周期盈余的重要用途，有助于调和高储蓄率与平稳的成人等价非耐用品消费之间的矛盾。定量分析显示，到45岁时，非住房耐用品存量增长约占累积生命周期盈余的三分之一，而将估算的非住房耐用品投资流加入非耐用品后，扩展的支出曲线使成人等价生命周期增长率从8.4%提升至27.9%。

title: Extreme Points and Majorization
title_zh: 极值点与优序化
title_primary: 极值点与优序化
title_secondary: Extreme Points and Majorization
authors: Andreas Kleiner, Benny Moldovanu, Philipp Strack
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: A key insight is that many, seemingly different, economic problems share a common mathematical structure: they all involve the maximization of a functional over sets of monotonic functions that are either majorized by, or majorize, a given function. We first present new, simpler proofs for the main characterization results of the extreme points of sets defined by monotonicity and majorization constraints obtained by Kleiner, Moldovanu, and Strack (2021). We then demonstrate how the characterization results can be fruitfully applied to a broad range of economic applications, from auction and information design to decision problems under risk such as optimal stopping. Finally, we conclude with an overview of recent, related work that extends these characterizations to settings with additional constraints, multidimensional state spaces, and alternative stochastic orders.
abstract_zh: 一个关键洞见在于，许多看似不同的经济问题共享一个共同的数学结构：它们都涉及在满足给定函数被单调函数族所支配或支配该函数的集合上，对泛函进行最大化。我们首先为Kleiner、Moldovanu和Strack（2021）所获得的关于由单调性和支配约束定义的集合的极值点的主要刻画结果，提供了新的、更简洁的证明。随后，我们展示了这些刻画结果如何有效地应用于广泛的经济场景，从拍卖与信息设计到风险下的决策问题，如最优停止。最后，我们总结近期相关工作，这些工作将这些刻画扩展至具有额外约束、多维状态空间及替代随机序的情境。

title: Mergers, Lobbying, and Elections: Is there a "Curse of Bigness"?
title_zh: 并购、游说与选举：是否存在“规模诅咒”？
title_primary: 并购、游说与选举：是否存在“规模诅咒”？
title_secondary: Mergers, Lobbying, and Elections: Is there a "Curse of Bigness"?
authors: Matteo Broso, Tommaso Valletti
official: 官方在线 2026-04-26 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the impact of mergers on quid-pro-quo lobbying and elections in a political agency model. Two incumbent firms can lobby an incumbent politician to block a pro-competitive reform. The politician’s type determines whether they are susceptible to the firms’ influence or not. A representative voter tries to infer the politician’s type monitoring the policy-making process. We show that lobbying increases when firms merge because rents from political protection are not dissipated by price competition. While greater market concentration may increase prices and political influence, it also improves voters’ ability to screen bad politicians by observing distorted policy outcomes. This generates a novel trade-off: mergers can harm consumers through market and political power, yet improve selection of politicians. We characterize when standard consumer welfare–based merger control is too lenient or too strict once these political economy effects are taken into account.
abstract_zh: 我们研究并购对政治代理模型中的互惠游说及选举的影响。两家在位企业可以游说现任政治家，以阻止一项促进竞争的改革。政治家的类型决定了他们是否易受企业影响。代表性选民通过监督政策制定过程，试图推断政治家的类型。我们证明，当企业合并时，游说活动增加，因为政治保护带来的租金未被价格竞争所消散。虽然更高的市场集中度可能提高价格和政治影响力，但它也通过观察扭曲的政策结果，提升了选民筛选不良政治家的能力。这产生了一种新的权衡：并购可能通过市场和政治权力损害消费者，却改善了政治家的筛选。我们刻画了在考虑这些政治经济效应后，基于消费者福利的标准并购控制何时过于宽松或过于严格。

title: Does state capitalism always lead corporate green technology innovation? Evidence from China
title_zh: 国家资本主义是否总能促进企业绿色技术创新？来自中国的证据
title_primary: 国家资本主义是否总能促进企业绿色技术创新？来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Does state capitalism always lead corporate green technology innovation? Evidence from China
authors: Yifan Chen, Xuanyi Shi, Wenjun Wu, Yutong Shi, Chunyang Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines how corporate green innovation is influenced by ultimate controlling shareholders, which we categorize into three institutional types: central government, local government, and private entities. Using 29,926 firm-year observations of A-share listed firms from 2009 to 2023 and panel fixed-effects models with industry-year and province-year joint fixed effects, we find that central state-owned enterprises (SOEs) significantly outperform others in green innovation willingness, quantity, and quality, while local SOEs and private enterprises show no significant difference. Mechanism tests reveal that central state-owned enterprises’ green innovation advantage is driven by greater social responsibility, whereas local state-owned enterprises’ regulatory bargaining power dampens their green innovation. Further analysis shows that central SOEs and local SOEs exhibit a stronger emphasis on non-R&D environmental transformation activities than private enterprises, suggesting differentiated compliance strategies across ownership types. These findings extend the ownership-innovation literature by demonstrating that the ownership hierarchy established for general innovation does not necessarily hold in the context of corporate green innovation, and provide new insights into the mechanisms through which state capitalism shapes firms’ green innovation. KEYWORDS: Green innovation state capitalism ultimate controlling shareholders responsible investment bargaining power JEL CLASSIFICATION: G32 G34 M14 Acknowledgements The authors express their gratitude to Dr. Jing Zhang of Xiamen University of Technology for her insightful comments. Any remaining errors are solely our responsibility.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了终极控制股东如何影响企业绿色创新，我们将终极控制股东划分为三种制度类型：中央政府、地方政府和私人实体。基于2009年至2023年间A股上市公司29,926个公司-年度观测值，并采用行业-年份和省份-年份联合固定效应的面板固定效应模型，我们发现中央国有企业（SOEs）在绿色创新意愿、数量和质量上显著优于其他类型企业，而地方国有企业和私营企业之间则无显著差异。机制检验揭示，中央国有企业的绿色创新优势源于更强的社会责任承担，而地方国有企业的监管议价能力则抑制了其绿色创新。进一步分析表明，中央国有企业和地方国有企业在非研发环境转型活动上的重视程度高于私营企业，这表明不同所有权类型的企业采取了差异化的合规策略。这些发现拓展了所有权-创新文献，证明了为一般创新建立的所有权层级在绿色创新背景下并不必然成立，并为国家资本主义如何塑造企业绿色创新的机制提供了新的见解。关键词：绿色创新；国家资本主义；终极控制股东；责任投资；议价能力JEL分类：G32 G34 M14致谢：作者感谢厦门理工学院张静博士的 insightful 评论。文中任何错误均由我们自行承担。

title: Can policy design build trust in local taxation? Experimental evidence of property taxation in Mexican municipalities
title_zh: 政策设计能否建立对地方税收的信任？墨西哥市政财产税的实验证据
title_primary: 政策设计能否建立对地方税收的信任？墨西哥市政财产税的实验证据
title_secondary: Can policy design build trust in local taxation? Experimental evidence of property taxation in Mexican municipalities
authors: Aurora Echavarria
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Property taxes, the primary source of local revenue for municipal governments, are essential for improving urban service provision and resident welfare. Yet this tax is widely unpopular and often politically contentiuous. This study's descriptive findings reveal that property owners are not currently motivated to pay their property taxes by the promise of collective benefits, but rather by the desire to secure their property rights. Thus, this study asks: What dimensions of property tax design do property owners prioritize? How do they negotiate trade-offs? And can policy design establish credible commitment? I address these questions using an experimental conjoint survey with over 2,000 property owners in 34 urban municipalities in Mexico. I find that property owners are largely indifferent to the progressivity of property tax increases yet strongly prioritize policies that enhance accountability in how government administers, spends, and enforces taxes. Specifically, the presence of active oversight strategies in the use of funds increases the support for a policy by 11 percentage points, an effect greater than that of policies that offer more direct benefits. Individuals with high perceptions of government corruption disproportionately favor tax policies that incorporate active transparency strategies even if this implies a higher fiscal burden. Overall, this study demonstrates that public support for property taxation is not entirely inelastic and that adopting accountability measures that signal how funds are spent can make property owners more accepting of tax increases. This study contributes to literature on the fiscal contract by demonstrating how policy designs that enhance accountability can help establish credible commitment.
abstract_zh: 财产税作为市政政府地方收入的主要来源，对于改善城市服务供给和居民福祉至关重要。然而，这一税种普遍不受欢迎，且常引发政治争议。本研究的描述性发现表明，业主目前并非因集体利益的承诺而缴纳财产税，而是出于保障自身产权的愿望。因此，本研究提出以下问题：业主优先关注财产税设计的哪些维度？他们如何权衡取舍？政策设计能否建立可信承诺？我通过在墨西哥34个城市市政区对超过2000名业主进行的实验性联合分析调查来解答这些问题。研究发现，业主对财产税增加的累进性基本不敏感，但强烈优先考虑增强政府在税收管理、支出和执行方面问责性的政策。具体而言，资金使用中积极监督策略的存在使政策支持率提高11个百分点，这一效果大于提供更直接利益的政策。对政府腐败感知较高的个体，即使这意味着更高的财政负担，也尤为倾向于支持包含积极透明策略的税收政策。总体而言，本研究证明公众对财产税的支持并非完全缺乏弹性，采取能表明资金使用方式的问责措施可使业主更易接受税收增加。本研究通过展示增强问责性的政策设计如何帮助建立可信承诺，为财政契约文献做出贡献。

title: DP6 Did the Catholics always have Larger Families? Religion, Wealth, and Fertility in Rural Ulster Before 1911
title_zh: DP6 天主教徒的家庭规模是否总是更大？1911年前阿尔斯特农村的宗教、财富与生育率
title_primary: DP6 天主教徒的家庭规模是否总是更大？1911年前阿尔斯特农村的宗教、财富与生育率
title_secondary: DP6 Did the Catholics always have Larger Families? Religion, Wealth, and Fertility in Rural Ulster Before 1911
authors: Cormac Ó Gráda
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Analysis of marital fertility in rural Derry c. 1911 confirms the presence even then of a gap between Catholics and Protestants. The difference was small, however, compared to today's, and for couples who had married before the mid-1880's it was insignificant. Various indicators of 'wealth' suggest that, all else equal, wealthier couples have more children, thereby suggesting that children are a 'normal good' in the economic sense. At given values of the 'wealth variables', labourers tend to have more children than farmers. Controlling for these economic factors tends to widen the fertility gap between Catholics and Protestants.
abstract_zh: 对1911年左右德里乡村地区婚内生育率的分析证实，当时天主教徒与新教徒之间已存在生育率差距。然而，这一差距与当今相比微乎其微，且在1880年代中期前结婚的夫妇中几乎可以忽略不计。多项"财富"指标表明，在其他条件相同的情况下，较富裕的夫妇生育更多子女，这暗示子女在经济意义上属于"正常商品"。在给定"财富变量"数值时，劳工阶层比农民阶层倾向于生育更多子女。控制这些经济因素后，天主教徒与新教徒之间的生育率差距反而扩大。

title: Time-Varying Cost of Distancing: Distancing Fatigue and Lockdowns
title_zh: 时变疏离成本：疏离疲劳与封锁措施
title_primary: 时变疏离成本：疏离疲劳与封锁措施
title_secondary: Time-Varying Cost of Distancing: Distancing Fatigue and Lockdowns
authors: Carnehl, Christoph, Fukuda, Satoshi, Kos, Nenad
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Microeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We study a behavioral SIR model with time-varying costs of distancing. We explore the consequences of distancing fatigue and public policies. For a second wave to arise, a steep increase in distancing cost is necessary. We introduce prudent distancing fatigue and show that it cannot trigger a second wave. Both prevalence and fatigue are single-peaked, with fatigue peaking after prevalence. However, policy changes that discontinuously increase distancing costs can cause a second wave, and we characterize the largest such change that avoids it. Finally, numerical analysis shows that an early strict lockdown can have unintended adverse effects.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个具有时变社交距离成本的行为SIR模型，探讨了社交距离疲劳与公共政策的后果。要引发第二波疫情，社交距离成本必须急剧上升。我们引入了审慎的社交距离疲劳概念，并证明其无法触发第二波疫情。患病率与疲劳程度均呈单峰形态，且疲劳峰值晚于患病率峰值。然而，导致社交距离成本不连续增加的政策变化可能引发第二波疫情，我们刻画了避免该情况的最大政策变动幅度。最后，数值分析表明，早期严格封锁可能产生非预期的负面效应。

title: The tragedy of the horizon: A contracting account
title_zh: 地平线的悲剧：一份契约解释
title_primary: 地平线的悲剧：一份契约解释
title_secondary: The tragedy of the horizon: A contracting account
authors: C. Cabolis, Karl Schmedders
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The “tragedy of the horizon” captures the gap between long-horizon climate damages and the shorter horizons of corporate decision-making. We provide a contracting account of this idea using a deliberately standard CARA-normal moral-hazard model. Under full commitment, the optimal linear contract can condition on long-horizon outcomes; horizon mismatch alone does not generate underinvestment. The tragedy arises when shareholders cannot credibly commit today to compensate a CEO based on outcomes verified after the contracting horizon. Restricting compensation to an interim signal yields a strict effort wedge relative to the full-commitment benchmark. The key comparative static is that the wedge is largest when the long-horizon outcome would have been most informative if contractible; that is, a more informative noncontractible long-horizon outcome does not close the gap. We also quantify the shareholder value of extending the contracting horizon. The implication is that climate-linked CEO pay can address the tragedy of the horizon only when the relevant metrics are both informative and contractible.
abstract_zh: 地平线悲剧”捕捉了长期气候损害与企业决策较短视野之间的差距。我们通过一个标准的CARA正态道德风险模型，对这一理念进行了契约层面的阐释。在完全承诺条件下，最优线性契约能够依据长期结果进行条件设定；仅凭视野错配并不足以导致投资不足。当股东今日无法可信地承诺依据契约期后验证的结果来补偿CEO时，悲剧便应运而生。将补偿限制于中期信号，相对于完全承诺基准，会产生严格的努力程度偏差。关键的比较静态分析显示，当长期结果若可契约化时最具信息量时，这一偏差达到最大；换言之，更具信息量的不可契约化长期结果并不能缩小这一差距。我们还量化了延长契约视野对股东价值的增益。其含义在于，只有当相关指标既具信息性又具可契约性时，与气候挂钩的CEO薪酬才能应对“地平线悲剧”。

title: Household Responses to Phantom Riches
title_zh: 家庭对虚幻财富的反应
title_primary: 家庭对虚幻财富的反应
title_secondary: Household Responses to Phantom Riches
authors: Petra Vokata, Samuli Knüpfer, Erkki Vihriälä
official: 官方在线 2026-07-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the consequences of investment fraud victimization using unique administrative data on Ponzi scheme investors. A matched control event-study design shows that the victims experience a six percent annual labor income loss. Income first declines when an investor joins the scheme, consistent with distorted beliefs lowering labor supply. The scheme’s collapse triggers a further decrease, which we attribute to financial stress. Investors also face higher indebtedness and tilt their portfolios away from delegated investments. The income loss persists in the long run, equals twice the direct investment loss, and substantially adds to the social cost of fraud.
abstract_zh: 我们利用庞氏骗局投资者的独特行政数据，研究了投资欺诈受害的经济后果。采用匹配控制事件研究设计发现，受害者每年劳动收入损失达6%。收入在投资者加入骗局时首次下降，这与扭曲信念降低劳动供给的结论一致。骗局崩溃引发进一步收入下降，我们将其归因于财务压力。投资者还面临更高的负债率，并调整投资组合减少委托投资。收入损失长期持续，相当于直接投资损失的两倍，显著增加了欺诈的社会成本。

title: Asymptotics of Cointegration Tests for High-Dimensional Var(k)
title_zh: 高维VAR(k)模型协整检验的渐近性质
title_primary: 高维VAR(k)模型协整检验的渐近性质
title_secondary: Asymptotics of Cointegration Tests for High-Dimensional Var(k)
authors: Anna Bykhovskaya, Vadim Gorin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The paper studies nonstationary high-dimensional vector autoregressions of order k, VAR(k). Additional deterministic terms such as trend or seasonality are allowed. The number of time periods, T, and the number of coordinates, N, are assumed to be large and of the same order. Under this regime the first-order asymptotics of the Johansen likelihood ratio (LR), Pillai-Bartlett, and Hotelling-Lawley tests for cointegration are derived: The test statistics converge to nonrandom integrals. For more refined analysis, the paper proposes and analyzes a modification of the Johansen test. The new test for the absence of cointegration converges to the partial sum of the Airy1 point process. Supporting Monte Carlo simulations indicate that the same behavior persists universally in many situations beyond those considered in our theorems. The paper presents empirical implementations of the approach for the analysis of S&P100 stocks and of cryptocurrencies. The latter example has a strong presence of multiple cointegrating relationships, while the results for the former are consistent with the null of no cointegration.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了非平稳高维向量自回归模型（阶数为k，记为VAR(k)），允许包含趋势或季节性等确定性项。假设时间期数T与坐标数N均较大且量级相同。在此框架下，推导了Johansen似然比（LR）、Pillai-Bartlett和Hotelling-Lawley协整检验的一阶渐近性质：检验统计量收敛于非随机积分。为进行更精细的分析，本文提出并分析了一种Johansen检验的修正形式。该新检验对无协整原假设的检验统计量收敛于Airy1点过程的部分和。蒙特卡洛模拟结果支持该行为在超出定理假设的多种情境下具有普遍性。本文将该方法应用于标普100指数股票和加密货币的实证分析。后者案例中多重协整关系显著存在，而前者结果与无协整原假设一致。

title: When Alpha Disappears: A One-Switch Benchmark for Decision-Time Leakage in Financial Backtests
title_zh: 当阿尔法消失时：金融回测中决策时点泄露的单次切换基准
title_primary: 当阿尔法消失时：金融回测中决策时点泄露的单次切换基准
title_secondary: When Alpha Disappears: A One-Switch Benchmark for Decision-Time Leakage in Financial Backtests
authors: Fan Zhang, Zhen Li, Sijia Peng, Yu Chen
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We introduce When Alpha Disappears, a paired evaluation benchmark for diagnosing decision-time leakage in financial machine-learning backtests. Rather than treating leakage as a binary property, the benchmark estimates protocol-induced inflation by toggling one evaluation convention at a time around a clean $t{+}1$-open reference, while holding the data panel, walk-forward split, model family, horizon, portfolio rule, and cost convention fixed. Across two daily-OHLCV equity panels, six model families, and yearly tests from 2016--2024, we find that inflation is highly selective: centered temporal features and same-day-open execution with post-open daily-bar information cause large and stable increases in both predictive and trading metrics, whereas global normalization, future-informed graph structure, and same-day-close execution are weak in most settings. The benchmark is diagnostic rather than a claim of tradable alpha, and is intended to make evaluation assumptions, failure modes, and protocol fragility directly measurable.
abstract_zh: 我们提出“当阿尔法消失时”这一配对评估基准，用于诊断金融机器学习回测中的决策时点信息泄露。该基准并非将信息泄露视为二元属性，而是通过围绕一个干净的t+1开盘参考点，每次切换一项评估惯例，同时固定数据面板、滚动窗口划分、模型家族、预测周期、投资组合规则及成本惯例，来估计协议引发的通胀效应。基于两个日频OHLCV股票面板、六个模型家族以及2016至2024年的年度测试，我们发现通胀具有高度选择性：中心化时序特征、同日开盘执行结合开盘后日频柱信息，会导致预测指标和交易指标均出现显著且稳定的提升；而全局归一化、基于未来信息的图结构以及同日收盘执行在大多数设定下影响较弱。该基准旨在进行诊断，而非声称存在可交易的阿尔法，其目的是使评估假设、失效模式及协议脆弱性变得可直接度量。

title: Economic warfare and sanctions since 1688 Stephen Broadberry and Mark Harrison, Eds., (Cambridge University Press, 2025. Pp. 298. ISBN 9781009474863. PbK £28).
title_zh: 《1688年以来的经济战与制裁》
title_primary: 《1688年以来的经济战与制裁》
title_secondary: Economic warfare and sanctions since 1688 Stephen Broadberry and Mark Harrison, Eds., (Cambridge University Press, 2025. Pp. 298. ISBN 9781009474863. PbK £28).
authors: Eric Golson
official: 官方在线 2026-06-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Few questions in economic history feel more urgent in 2026 than those posed at the opening of this volume. That is, when one country tries to damage another's trade or resources, what results are to be expected, why have those results so often been disappointed, and can economic measures be effective if unaccompanied by force, or the credible threat of it? Professors Stephen Broadberry and Mark Harrison, whose previous collaborations on the economics of the two world wars set the standard for the field, have assembled a team of leading scholars to look for answers across three centuries. The result is a volume that is at once both a worthy successor to those earlier collections and a distinctive intervention in current debates about the use of sanctions against Iran, Russia, China, and others. It complements the recent work of Nicholas Mulder (The economic weapon, 2022) and Lance Davis and Stanley Engerman (Naval blockades in peace and war, 2006) by extending the chronology and broadening the comparative framework.
abstract_zh: 在2026年，经济史中几乎没有比本卷开篇提出的问题更为紧迫的了。即，当一个国家试图损害另一国的贸易或资源时，预期会产生何种结果，为何这些结果常常令人失望，以及如果经济措施没有武力或可信武力威胁的伴随，它们能否有效？斯蒂芬·布罗德伯里教授和马克·哈里森教授，他们此前在两次世界大战经济学方面的合作树立了该领域的标杆，现已召集了一支顶尖学者团队，跨越三个世纪寻找答案。其结果是一部既是对早期文集当之无愧的继承，又是对当前关于对伊朗、俄罗斯、中国等国制裁辩论的独特介入之作。它通过延长时间跨度和拓宽比较框架，补充了尼古拉斯·穆尔德（《经济武器》，2022年）和兰斯·戴维斯与斯坦利·恩格尔曼（《和平与战争中的海上封锁》，2006年）近期的研究。

title: Political empowerment and marital practices
title_zh: 政治赋权与婚姻实践
title_primary: 政治赋权与婚姻实践
title_secondary: Political empowerment and marital practices
authors: Priyama Majumdar
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Despite decades of reform, early marriage and dowry remain pervasive in rural India. I examine whether women's political representation shifts these practices. I develop a model in which households choose daughters' marriage timing and dowry, facing social penalties for non-marriage. Female leaders, by expanding women's economic opportunities, increase the value of daughters and delay marriage. When social penalties are high, delays raise dowry. I test this using exogenous variation from India's 1992 constitutional amendment, which reserved one-third of village council (pradhan) seats for women. Data from a representative rural survey shows that female pradhans delay marriage by 1.22 years and increase dowry by 68%. A 29% rise in female labor force participation partly explains the delay. Dowry increases are concentrated in patriarchal states, where penalties for non-marriage are most severe. The findings highlight both the potential and the limits of political empowerment in transforming marital norms under binding social constraints.
abstract_zh: 尽管历经数十年改革，童婚与嫁妆在印度农村地区依然普遍存在。本文考察女性政治代表权是否改变了这些习俗。我构建了一个模型，其中家庭在面临未婚的社会惩罚时，会选择女儿的结婚时机与嫁妆。女性领导人通过拓宽女性的经济机会，提升了女儿的价值并推迟了婚龄。当社会惩罚较高时，推迟婚龄会增加嫁妆。我利用印度1992年宪法修正案产生的外生变异进行检验，该修正案将村务委员会（pradhan）席位的三分之一保留给女性。来自代表性农村调查的数据显示，女性pradhan使婚龄推迟了1.22年，并使嫁妆增加了68%。女性劳动力参与率上升29%部分解释了这一推迟现象。嫁妆的增加集中在父权制邦，这些地区对未婚的社会惩罚最为严重。研究结果凸显了在刚性社会约束下，政治赋权在转变婚姻规范方面的潜力与局限。

authors: Tan Gan, Nicholas Wu
official: 官方在线 2026-06-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: An informed seller designs a dynamic mechanism to sell an experience good. The seller has partial information about the product match, which affects the buyer's private consumption experience. We characterize equilibrium mechanisms of this dynamic informed principal problem. The belief gap between the informed seller and the uninformed buyer, coupled with the buyer's learning, gives rise to mechanisms that provide the skeptical buyer with limited access to the product and an option to upgrade if the buyer is swayed by a good experience. Depending on the seller's screening technology, this takes the form of free/discounted trials or tiered pricing, which are prevalent in digital markets. In contrast to static environments, having consumer data can reduce sellers' revenue in equilibrium, as they fine-tune the dynamic design with their data forecasting the buyer's learning process.
abstract_zh: 一位知情卖方设计了一个动态机制来销售体验型商品。卖方对产品匹配度拥有部分信息，这影响买方私人的消费体验。我们刻画了这一动态知情委托人问题中的均衡机制。知情卖方与不知情买方之间的信念差距，加之买方的学习过程，催生了这样的机制：为持怀疑态度的买方提供有限的产品接触机会，并在买方因良好体验而动摇时给予升级选项。根据卖方的筛选技术，这表现为免费或折扣试用，或分级定价，这些在数字市场中普遍存在。与静态环境相比，拥有消费者数据可能降低卖方在均衡中的收入，因为他们利用数据预测买方的学习过程，从而微调动态设计。

Because robots incur lower adjustment costs than human labor, a higher robot-to-labor ratio enhances operational flexibility. authors: Onur Ulas Ince, Tanya Molodtsova
official: 官方在线 2025-08-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article evaluates the out-of-sample exchange rate predictability of exchange rate models using real-time and revised data for 10 countries from 1973 to 2024 across short and long forecast horizons. Employing directional change tests and economic evaluation, we find that real-time data significantly enhances the performance of the most successful specifications at the shortest forecast horizon. However, this advantage is more elusive at longer horizons, as data revisions correct initial errors. We examine the models based on monetary, purchasing power parity, and Taylor rule fundamentals, as well as the uncovered interest rate parity model augmented with inflation. Using real-time data, models with Taylor-rule fundamentals exhibit superior predictive accuracy at the shortest horizon and offer the highest economic gains at all forecast horizons, while the UIRP model augmented with either U.S. and foreign inflation or U.S. inflation demonstrates superior predictive ability over longer horizons. Notably, the UIRP model with inflation shows stronger directional accuracy with real-time data at all horizons than with revised data. Additionally, we introduce geopolitical risk into the model with Taylor rule fundamentals to capture uncertainty from wars, terrorism, and political tensions. This model yields the highest economic gains and superior out-of-sample performance at the 1-quarter horizon.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了汇率模型在样本外汇率可预测性方面的表现，利用1973年至2024年间10个国家的实时与修订数据，覆盖短期和长期预测区间。通过方向变化检验和经济评估，我们发现实时数据显著提升了最成功模型在最短预测区间内的表现。然而，在较长区间内这一优势较难维持，因为数据修订修正了初始误差。我们考察了基于货币、购买力平价和泰勒规则基本面的模型，以及加入通胀因素的无抛补利率平价模型。使用实时数据时，泰勒规则基本面模型在最短区间内展现出卓越的预测准确性，并在所有预测区间内提供最高的经济收益，而加入美国及外国通胀或仅美国通胀的UIRP模型在较长区间内表现出更强的预测能力。值得注意的是，加入通胀的UIRP模型在所有区间内使用实时数据时，方向准确性均优于修订数据。此外，我们将地缘政治风险引入泰勒规则基本面模型，以捕捉战争、恐怖主义和政治紧张局势带来的不确定性。该模型在1季度区间内实现了最高的经济收益和优越的样本外表现。
